content.headline: Leading the way.
content.subheadline: Flatbed towing and recovery out of North Haverhill, New Hampshire, 23.5 hours a day. One call reaches the owner.
content.about: Finish Line Towing is Joshua Aldrich. He worked a year towing for someone else, bought that man's truck so he could cover more hours, and has run it out of North Haverhill since July 2021. It's one flatbed, kept clean enough to win truck shows, and the phone goes to him. In his words: "I started in this business as an opportunity to provide for our area, with services much needed."

faq.a: 23.5 hours a day, seven days a week — everybody sleeps sometime. It's a small outfit, so you're reaching the owner directly rather than a dispatch center.

faq.q: Is it a flatbed or a wheel-lift?
faq.a: Flatbed. Your vehicle rides on the deck instead of being dragged on two wheels, which is what you want for anything low, all-wheel drive, classic, or already damaged.
585 Benton Road, North Haverhill, NH 03774, in Grafton County.

faq.q: How long have you been doing this?
faq.a: Finish Line Towing, LLC was formed in July 2021 and is registered and in good standing with the State of New Hampshire.

content.legal: Rates depend on distance, vehicle, and conditions, and are quoted before the truck rolls.
